description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.focusManager class, which manages focus and blur events for CKEditor instances, including methods to set focus, handle focus loss with delay, and trigger focus/blur events.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.focusManager
classes.description: Class managing focus activity within a CKEditor instance, providing methods to focus, blur, and force blur with event firing.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the editor instance, updating focus state and firing focus event.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous blur with a 100ms delay, eventually calling forceBlur.

methods.name: forceBlur
methods.description: Immediately removes focus from the editor instance, updating focus state and firing blur event.
